description: List the police outcomes recorded in one month inside an area — a point with a 1-mile radius, a polygon, a location_id, or a neighbourhood — for crimes recorded that month or any earlier one. Returns the total, counts by outcome and by the month each crime was recorded, and a page of outcomes, each with its crime and persistent_id. Use it for what police resolved in a month; ukcrime_search_crimes gives the latest outcome of the crimes recorded in a month instead. Court results are not published; the result says when a force publishes no outcomes.

area.description: Area to search: 'point' (lat and lng; a 1-mile radius), 'polygon' (polygon), 'location' (location_id), or 'neighbourhood' (force and neighbourhood_id). An area field the chosen area does not use is rejected.

category.description: Count only outcomes for crimes in this category: a slug such as 'burglary' or a display name such as 'Violence and sexual offences'; case-insensitive, and spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other ('vehicle_crime' finds 'vehicle-crime'). Omitted or 'all-crime': every category. ukcrime_list_reference topic 'categories' lists them.

force.description: For area 'neighbourhood', with neighbourhood_id: a force id such as 'leicestershire', or its name such as 'Leicestershire Police' (ukcrime_list_reference topic 'forces' lists both); case-insensitive, spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other, '&' matches 'and', and a trailing 'Police', 'Police Service' or 'Constabulary' is optional.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

lng.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

location_id.description: For area 'location': location.location_id from an earlier result — one anonymised map point.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Omitted: the latest published month, echoed as month in the result.

neighbourhood_id.description: For area 'neighbourhood', with force: a neighbourhood id from ukcrime_list_reference topic 'neighbourhoods', or from ukcrime_find_neighbourhood for a point. Case-sensitive; only trimmed.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page; pass next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

polygon.description: For area 'polygon': 3–2,500 vertices as { lat, lng } objects, or the string 'lat,lng:lat,lng:…'. The ring closes itself (the last vertex joins the first). [lng, lat] pairs are not accepted.

items.description: One polygon vertex as { lat, lng }.

name: ukcrime_search_outcomes

area.description: The area as the server searched it.

force.description: Force id, when the area names one.

located_force.description: Force covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

located_forces.description: For 'polygon': forces its bounding-box centre and outermost vertices were located in, sorted; a point whose lookup failed adds none. Absent when none was located.

located_neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

by_crime_month.description: Matched outcomes by the month their crime was recorded, newest first.

items.description: A crime month and its count.

by_outcome.description: Matched outcomes by outcome, most first.

category.description: The crime category counted; absent when every category was (no category, or 'all-crime').

data_note.description: What these records can and cannot say; read it first.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_area`: the area's required fields are missing, or a field it does not use is present. `month_not_published`: month is after the latest published month. `month_out_of_range`: month is before the 36-month window. `unknown_category`: category matches no category slug or name. `unknown_force`: force matches no listed force id or name, or more than one, or is 'btp' (British Transport Police has no neighbourhoods). `unknown_neighbourhood`: the force has no neighbourhood with this id (ids are case-sensitive). `unknown_location`: data.police.uk holds no map point with this location_id. `area_too_large`: the area holds more than 10,000 outcomes, which data.police.uk refuses to answer. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

month.description: The month searched — when the outcomes were recorded — YYYY-MM.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Defaulted month, coverage gaps, why a result is empty, and how to page on.

outcomes.description: This page of matched outcomes, sorted by the crime's month, newest first, then crime id.

items.description: One police outcome and its crime.

code.description: Outcome code, such as under-investigation or unable-to-prosecute.

crime.description: The crime this outcome was recorded for.

location.description: Absent when the crime has no location.

location_id.description: Map point id; pass it as location_id with area 'location'.

map_point.description: Anonymised point covering at least eight addresses, not where it happened. Absent when unpublished.

subtype.description: Station or premises type, when published.

type.description: 'BTP': a British Transport Police station record; 'Force': a territorial force's.

month.description: Month recorded, YYYY-MM; can be years before the outcome.

persistent_id.description: Id ukcrime_get_crime_outcomes takes for the full history. Absent when unpublished.

total.description: Outcomes matched, after the category filter.

truncated.description: True when more rows remain after this page.

unfiltered_total.description: Outcomes recorded in the area and month before the category filter.

title: Search UK Police Outcomes
